name: SM_Wall_Plaster_Straight_A

dresses: straight 2.5 m run: sill beam, top plate, a post at the left end and one mid-span, two plaster bays. The right end has no post: the next module's left post (or an End/CornerPost module) closes it. For int_wall_plaster_side the same module is yawed 90 degrees

uv_channels.0: tiling, world-planar at the set tile size (2.5 m plaster and masonry, 3 m timber) with a per-module offset; timbers map inside single boards
